message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-12 13:10 IST to 2026-11-13 13:10 IST (2026-11-12 07:40 UTC to 2026-11-13 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only. Product names and obvious aliases were normalized and duplicate entries were merged. Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt were not read or combined.

One high-confidence match was found for the assigned DLL inventory: a newly published high-severity Telerik Reporting vulnerability. The mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep also found fresh reporting on one critical MongoDB Server issue; MongoDB is not present in the DLL file and is identified separately below.

### CVE-2026-106140 - Telerik Reporting report designers

- **Affected product/component:** Progress Telerik Reporting .NET Framework report designers before 20.3.26.1110.
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.3.
- **Description:** Deserialization of untrusted data can let a local, low-privileged attacker execute arbitrary code in the report designer process when a user performs certain editing operations. The .NET 8+ report designer is not affected.
- **Relevance:** DLL_software_component.txt lists Telerik Reporting 13.2.19.1030 and 19.3.25.1111, both below the fixed version. Exposure depends on whether the affected .NET Framework report designer is installed and used; the inventory entry alone does not prove that runtime condition.
- **Freshness:** The CVE record was published on 2026-11-12 at 09:42 UTC, inside this scan window.
- **Sources:** [Progress Telerik advisory](https://www.telerik.com/products/reporting/documentation/knowledge-base/kb-security-deserialization-of-untrusted-data-cve-2026-106140), [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security advisory](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/progress-software-security-advisory-av26-1148)

### Mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep - CVE-2026-118383

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Server replica-set members, including shard and config-server members; standalone mongod instances are not affected.
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.5 (MongoDB vendor score).
- **Description:** A pre-authentication use-after-free in primary catch-up can crash a replica-set member and, according to the vendor, may permit code execution under some conditions. Datadog reproduced a crash but did not demonstrate code execution.
- **Relevance:** This item comes from the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep, not from DLL_software_component.txt. New public reporting on November 12 fell inside this run's window; MongoDB originally announced the security update on November 10.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB announcement](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/important-mongodb-security-update-available-action-required-november-10-2026/344843), [Datadog Security Labs analysis](https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/cve-2026-118383-mongodb-server-use-after-free/), [The Hacker News report](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-pre-auth-mongodb-flaw-cve-2026.html)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research. No other MongoDB-category finding survived the freshness, credibility, and deduplication checks for this window.

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended for deployments containing the listed Telerik Reporting versions where the .NET Framework report designer is installed or used. The critical MongoDB item warrants separate review for any replica-set deployment covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
